samples.question: Trace the one connected route in increasing station-number order. The token starts in state A, B, or C as shown by its colored start badge (red=A, green=B, blue=C). At each station, a right triangle advances the state one step A-B-C-A, a left triangle moves it one step backward, and an outlined square leaves it unchanged. Record the state after every station. Which state has the longest uninterrupted run in that record? Answer A, B, or C.
